title: Scientists discover Greenland sharks can see for centuries, debunking blindness myth
content: Recent studies reveal that Greenland sharks possess well-preserved visual systems that can last for centuries, challenging the previous notion that they were nearly blind. Research shows that their eyes are uniquely suited for low-light environments, demonstrating impressive adaptability. Scientists found healthy rod cells and active genes responsible for light detection, indicating these sharks have a remarkable ability to maintain their eyesight throughout their extended lifespans.

content: Kerala receives around 3,000 mm of annual rainfall, often in uneven, high-intensity spells that are becoming more frequent and extreme, exacerbated by global warming and climate change

title: Udhayanidhi Stalin arrested in connection with complaint of making misogynist remarks
content: The complaints against him include allegations that he made indecent, double-entendre remarks that seemed to be directed at an actor during his speech

title: Madras High Court agrees to hear urgently the anticipatory bail plea of Udhayanidhi Stalin
content: Justice G.K. Ilanthiraiyan accepts a request made by senior counsel Hasan Mohamed Jinnah for hearing the case on the same day

title: Sivankutty accuses UDF govt. in Kerala of scapegoating official to divert attention from Congress-BJP deal on councillor Sugathan
content: CPI(M) leader alleges that the ‘rescue operation’ for the BJP councillor to secure leave and avoid disqualification was Congress’s repayment of its debt for vote trading in the recent elections

title: Missing minor traced in Vijayawada within 24 hours, reunited with parents
content: West Godavari Superintendent of Police Adnan Nayeem Asmi said the girl was traced through CCTV footage along the routes she had taken, after her parents lodged a complaint with the Tanuku police

title: Heavy rain lashes north Kerala; Bayar in Kasaragod records highest rainfall
content: Water levels in Muvattupuzha and Thodupuzha rivers continued to remain above warning range on Tuesday morning, though the levels were receding

title: Kerala floods 2026: death toll climbs to 18 even as rain intensity abates
content: CM Satheesan says the situation in most districts is now under control following a decline in rainfall. Eighteen people lost their lives in rain-related incidents, while three others remain missing, according to official figures.

title: Kerala govt to set up pilot disaster resilience system in Pathanamthitta, says V.D. Satheesan
content: CM reviews flood relief operations in the district, says system to comprise a denser network of rain gauges and advanced early warning mechanism; confirms reports of a major landslide and several minor landslips inside forest areas

title: Crackdown on digital fraud: SC orders action, gives strict directions to RBI
content: the apex court directed banks, financial intermediaries, regulators and law enforcement agencies to work together to curb the rising menace of "digital arrest" scams . the court called for a coordinated institutional response, including faster grievance redressal, stronger mechanisms to restore victims' money and wider public awareness campaigns .

title: 'Insult to nation': Mamata attacks BJP over Netaji remarks, armtwisting TMC leaders
content: Mamata Banerjee accused the BJP of disrespecting Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose . she urged people to protest against what she described as attacks on his legacy . the remarks came a day after netaji's grandnephew resigned from the TMC .

title: Watch: Guatemala on high alert as Fuego volcano erupts near capital
